prompt: Use case: editorial illustration. Create ONE portrait full-bleed book-cover illustration for the Czech reflective journal 'Osobní mapa na 12 měsíců'. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its exquisite hand-painted tarot artistry, subtle brush texture, restrained antique gold, luminous cream, deep midnight navy and layered natural landscape; do not copy its angel, lettering or card border. A winding path follows a river between cypress groves and olive trees toward a single warm golden light on the distant horizon. Night is giving way to a very faint amber dawn; sky remains rich inky blue. On the small stone ledge at the LOWER EDGE OF THE ILLUSTRATED SCENE, just above the middle of the whole cover, place a beautifully crafted tiny antique brass compass beside a folded hand-drawn map and a restrained olive sprig. A few small fine gold celestial marks can be worked into the arch stone, meaningful and understated, never glowing UI geometry. Composition is crafted for a beautiful printed book, sophisticated, intimate and painterly, no people. Art mainly occupies the upper 60 percent. IMPORTANT layout: top 10 percent should be very dark navy stone with low detail for a small publisher line; lower 32 percent should be dark navy painted stone and cloth, naturally quiet and low contrast, enough negative space for typeset title and customer name which will be added later. Do not add any letters, words, numbers, logo, typography, frame or border. Do not draw a book mockup. Render the illustration itself, portrait approximately A4 proportions. Avoid purple nebula, 3D render, glossy fantasy game art, photorealism, plastic gradients, grey fog, excessive stars, ornate clutter. Preserve the reference's romantic oil-painting quality while giving this scene its own identity.
